title: On Setting the chest by the door
subtitle: 日常生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）
meta: 主题语境：日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）　|　核心词汇：set　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 set 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1952 the builder ① set the chest by the door before dawn, and every assistant in the site said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three months on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the builder ② sets the chest by the door in public without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ set the chest by the door at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ set the chest by the door before — a line in the plan for October 1946 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Setting the chest by the door before dawn, the builder said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the beam at the far wall, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ set the date for the second meeting in public, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Set the date for the second meeting at once and never mention it again.

By 1959 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the plan, and a new assistant from the next site ⑧ sets the date for the second meeting before dawn every month without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the wall, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ set the chest by the door again when nobody else would.

⑩ To set the chest by the door, my mother said in 1964, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the site remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the site forgets, somebody sets the chest by the door in public again and somebody must set the chest by the door before dawn all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 放下（一般过去式 set the chest by the door：1952 年施工员头一回这样做，天没亮就）
B. v. 放下（一般现在 sets the chest by the door：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 放下（不定式 to set the chest by the door：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 放下（过去完成时 had set the chest by the door：1946 年十月的施工图上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 放下（动名词 setting the chest by the door 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 确定（set the date for the second meeting：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去确定把第二次聚会的日子定下）
G. v. 确定（set the date for the second meeting：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 放下（后段两处：新来的帮工照例 sets the date for the second meeting，而母亲又一次 set the chest by the door）

answers.why: set 意为“放下”，1952 年施工员天没亮就放下把箱子放在门口，那是工地里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 set。
set 意为“放下”，自那以后施工员当着众人面把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 sets。
set 意为“放下”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯放下把箱子放在门口”，此处为不定式 to set the chest by the door。
set 意为“放下”，施工图里 十月 那行字说明早在 1959 年之前就有人放下过，故用过去完成时 had set。
set 意为“放下”，施工员说“放下把箱子放在门口这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 setting the chest by the door 作主语。
set 意为“确定”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去确定把第二次聚会的日子定下”，should ever 之后用原形 set the date for the second meeting。
set 意为“确定”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻确定把第二次聚会的日子定下（set the date for the second meeting at once），以后再也不要提起。
set 意为“放下”，新来的帮工每个月份都照例确定把第二次聚会的日子定下，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 sets。
set 意为“放下”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次天没亮就放下把箱子放在门口，用一般过去式 set 叙述。
set 意为“放下”，结尾那句是母亲 1964 年的话：要放下把箱子放在门口，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和工地记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 set 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1952 the builder set the chest by the door before dawn, and nobody in the site forgot it.
Even now the builder sets the chest by the door in public whenever the site asks.
Setting the chest by the door before dawn, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever set the date for the second meeting in public, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new assistant from the next site sets the date for the second meeting before dawn every month, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother set the chest by the door again, and the site remembered that half.
